workflow_instructions.mode_overview: Playwright Test Generator mode converts structured test specifications into comprehensive, maintainable Playwright tests following Page Object Model patterns.

step.details: Parse specs/.md to understand: - Application overview - Test scenarios with steps - Expected results - Test data requirements

Check existing structure: - tests/seed.spec.ts or tests/seed.spec.py for patterns - tests/e2e/ui/pages/ for existing Page Objects - tests/e2e/ui/conftest.py for fixtures - tests/e2e/ui/tasks/ for helper functions

phase.name: analysis
phase.description: Analyze spec and identify implementation needs

steps.step: Map each test scenario to a test function
Identify UI elements that need Page Object methods
Identify required fixtures and test data
Determine if new Page Objects are needed
Use web-crawler skill to fetch Playwright docs
Convert documentation to markdown using web-to-markdown skill
Extract relevant patterns for locators and assertions

phase.name: page_object_creation
phase.description: Create or update Page Object Models

steps.step: Create new Page Object classes for UI components
Add methods for user interactions
Add properties for locators
Include FN: documentation headers
Create test file in tests/e2e/ui/ directory
Add FN: documentation headers
Implement test functions following spec scenarios
Use Page Objects for UI interactions
Implement assertions based on expected results
Check test follows project conventions
Verify locators are semantic and resilient
Ensure assertions are specific and meaningful
Confirm FN: headers are complete

pattern.name: test_from_scenario
pattern.description: Convert spec scenario to test function

pattern.name: page_object_with_locators
pattern.description: Create Page Object with semantic locators

completion_criteria.criterion: Test file created in tests/e2e/ui/ directory
All scenarios from spec have corresponding test functions
Page Objects created/updated for UI components
FN: documentation headers are complete and accurate
